name: Objective-Function Obfuscation via Base-4 Evaluation
description: Instead of explicitly describing the lexicographical comparison which models easily map to "first solution found by index-ordered DFS", we define the tie-breaking rule as minimizing the scalar value $\sum_{i=1}^n t_i \cdot 4^{n-i}$. Because $t_i \in \{1, 2, 3\}$, this sum is strictly minimized by the lexicographically smallest sequence. Models that don't recognize this equivalence might try to find all valid assignments and evaluate the sum, which will TLE on $n=40$.
